items.question: Trong câu "If you do not measure, you do not know whether you are creating value or merely staying busy.", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you do not measure, you do not know whether you are creating value or merely staying busy.", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the size or amount of something
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (động từ): đo lường. Cũng là danh từ: "a measure" = một thước đo; "measure outcomes" = đo lường kết quả.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (verb): to find the size or amount of something. Also a noun: "a measure" is a yardstick; "measure outcomes" means tracking results.

items.question: Trong câu "If you do not measure, you do not know whether you are creating value or merely staying busy.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you do not measure, you do not know whether you are creating value or merely staying busy.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn thuần. Dùng để giảm nhẹ: "merely staying busy" = chỉ đơn thuần là bận rộn, không tạo ra giá trị.
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (adverb): only, nothing more than. Used to play something down: "merely staying busy" means just being busy, not adding value.

items.question: Trong câu "A team can ship steadily every sprint for six months while the product gets no better at all.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team can ship steadily every sprint for six months while the product gets no better at all.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to release a product or feature
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành (sản phẩm). Trong ngành phần mềm, "ship a feature" = đưa tính năng tới tay người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product or feature. In software, "ship a feature" means putting it in users' hands.

items.question: Trong câu "A team can ship steadily every sprint for six months while the product gets no better at all.", từ "steadily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team can ship steadily every sprint for six months while the product gets no better at all.", what does "steadily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: steadily /ˈsted.əl.i/ (trạng từ): đều đặn. Tính từ: steady (ổn định, đều). "Grow steadily" = tăng trưởng đều đặn.
items.explanationEn: steadily /ˈsted.əl.i/ (adverb): at a regular, even pace. Adjective: steady. "Grow steadily" means grow at an even pace.

items.question: Trong câu "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", từ "drain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", what does "drain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drain /dreɪn/ (động từ): vơi dần, cạn dần. Nghĩa gốc là thoát nước; "the backlog drains" = backlog vơi dần vì việc được làm xong.
items.explanationEn: drain /dreɪn/ (verb): to empty gradually. Literally water flowing out; "the backlog drains" means items are being cleared.

items.question: Trong câu "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. Danh từ không đếm được: "no evidence that…" = không có bằng chứng rằng…
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): proof that something is true. Uncountable: "no evidence that…" means nothing proves that…

items.question: Trong câu "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", từ "better off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Velocity is high, the backlog drains, everyone is busy — but there is no evidence that users are better off or the business earns more.", what does "better off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: better off /ˌbet.ər ˈɒf/ (cụm từ): ở tình trạng tốt hơn. Trái nghĩa: worse off. "Users are better off" = người dùng được lợi hơn.
items.explanationEn: better off /ˌbet.ər ˈɒf/ (phrase): in a better situation. Opposite: worse off. "Users are better off" means users have gained something.

items.question: Trong câu "Measurement serves three different purposes, and mixing them causes endless argument:", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measurement serves three different purposes, and mixing them causes endless argument:", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑː.ɡjə.mənt/ (danh từ): sự tranh cãi. Trong lập trình, argument còn là đối số của hàm; ở đây là tranh cãi giữa người với người.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑː.ɡjə.mənt/ (noun): disagreement, debate. In programming it also means a function argument; here it means people disagreeing.

items.question: Trong câu "A metric used for learning must be treated differently from a metric used to judge people.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A metric used for learning must be treated differently from a metric used to judge people.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): đối xử, xử lý. "Treat A differently from B" = đối xử với A khác với B.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to deal with or handle. "Treat A differently from B" means handling A in another way than B.

items.question: Trong câu "A metric used for learning must be treated differently from a metric used to judge people.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A metric used for learning must be treated differently from a metric used to judge people.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá, phán xét. Danh từ judge = thẩm phán. "Judge people by a number" = đánh giá con người bằng con số.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to form an opinion about. As a noun, a judge sits in court. "Judge people by a number" means rating them by it.

items.question: Trong câu "The moment a metric becomes an individual performance measure, it loses all value as a learning tool — because people start optimising the number instead of the outcome.", từ "optimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moment a metric becomes an individual performance measure, it loses all value as a learning tool — because people start optimising the number instead of the outcome.", what does "optimise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make as good as possible
items.explanation: optimise /ˈɒp.tɪ.maɪz/ (động từ): tối ưu hóa. Chính tả Anh: optimise; Mỹ: optimize. "Optimise for X" = tối ưu theo X.
items.explanationEn: optimise /ˈɒp.tɪ.maɪz/ (verb): to make as good as possible. British spelling optimise, American optimize. "Optimise for X" means aim to maximise X.

items.question: Trong câu "The moment a metric becomes an individual performance measure, it loses all value as a learning tool — because people start optimising the number instead of the outcome.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The moment a metric becomes an individual performance measure, it loses all value as a learning tool — because people start optimising the number instead of the outcome.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả thực tế. Phân biệt outcome (kết quả/tác động) với output (sản lượng đầu ra).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): the real result or effect. Contrast outcome (effect) with output (the amount produced).

items.question: Trong câu "A vanity metric looks good in a report but leads to no action.", từ "vanity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vanity metric looks good in a report but leads to no action.", what does "vanity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vanity /ˈvæn.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự phù phiếm, hào nhoáng. "Vanity metric" = chỉ số phù phiếm: trông đẹp nhưng không giúp ra quyết định.
items.explanationEn: vanity /ˈvæn.ə.ti/ (noun): pride in appearance, emptiness. A "vanity metric" looks impressive but does not guide decisions.

items.question: Trong câu "Three questions to spot one:", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three questions to spot one:", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): nhận ra, phát hiện. Danh từ spot = vết, chỗ. "Spot a problem" = phát hiện vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice or identify. As a noun, a spot is a mark or place. "Spot a problem" means notice one.

items.question: Trong câu "If this number doubled, what would I do differently?", từ "double" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this number doubled, what would I do differently?", what does "double" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (động từ): tăng gấp đôi. "Double" có thể là động từ, tính từ hoặc danh từ; ở đây là tăng gấp đôi.
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (verb): to become twice as large. Double can be a verb, adjective or noun; here it means grow twofold.

items.question: Trong câu "Is it tied to a valuable behaviour?", từ "tied to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is it tied to a valuable behaviour?", what does "tied to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tied to /ˈtaɪd tuː/ (cụm từ): gắn liền với. "Be tied to" = gắn với, phụ thuộc vào. "Bonus tied to results" = thưởng gắn với kết quả.
items.explanationEn: tied to /ˈtaɪd tuː/ (phrase): closely linked to. "Be tied to" means linked to. "A bonus tied to results" depends on results.

items.question: Trong câu "A page view is not value; completing a transaction is.", từ "transaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A page view is not value; completing a transaction is.", what does "transaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (danh từ): giao dịch. "Complete a transaction" = hoàn tất giao dịch; trong CSDL còn là một đơn vị thao tác.
items.explanationEn: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (noun): a purchase or exchange. "Complete a transaction" means finish a purchase; in databases it is a unit of work.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", từ "cumulative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", what does "cumulative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cumulative /ˈkjuː.mjə.lə.tɪv/ (tính từ): cộng dồn, lũy kế. Chỉ số cộng dồn chỉ tăng chứ không giảm, nên luôn trông đẹp.
items.explanationEn: cumulative /ˈkjuː.mjə.lə.tɪv/ (adjective): adding up over time. A cumulative total can only rise, so it always looks good.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", từ "cohort" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", what does "cohort" (noun) mean?
options: nhóm người dùng cùng đặc điểm
items.explanation: cohort /ˈkəʊ.hɔːt/ (danh từ): nhóm người dùng cùng đặc điểm. "Cohort analysis" = phân tích theo nhóm, ví dụ nhóm đăng ký cùng tuần.
items.explanationEn: cohort /ˈkəʊ.hɔːt/ (noun): a group sharing a trait. "Cohort analysis" compares groups, e.g. users who signed up in the same week.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful metric is usually a RATIO or a cohort figure, rarely a cumulative absolute number.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. Trái nghĩa với usually; "usually X, rarely Y" = thường là X, hiếm khi là Y.
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (adverb): not often. Opposite of usually; "usually X, rarely Y" contrasts the common and uncommon case.

items.question: Trong câu "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", từ "lagging" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", what does "lagging" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lagging /ˈlæɡ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): theo sau, trễ. Động từ lag = tụt lại sau. "Lagging indicator" phản ánh điều đã xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: lagging /ˈlæɡ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): trailing behind, after the fact. Verb lag = fall behind. A "lagging indicator" reflects what already happened.

items.question: Trong câu "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a guide who shows the way
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): chỉ số, dấu hiệu. "Key performance indicator (KPI)" = chỉ số hiệu suất chính.
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a sign or measure. "Key performance indicator (KPI)" is a main measure of performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", từ "revenue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", what does "revenue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: revenue /ˈrev.ən.juː/ (danh từ): doanh thu. Revenue là tổng tiền thu vào; profit là phần còn lại sau khi trừ chi phí.
items.explanationEn: revenue /ˈrev.ən.juː/ (noun): income from sales. Revenue is all money coming in; profit is what remains after costs.

items.question: Trong câu "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", từ "churn" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lagging indicators measure OUTCOMES that already happened: revenue, churn, profit.", what does "churn" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: churn /tʃɜːn/ (danh từ): tỉ lệ khách rời bỏ. "Churn rate" = tỉ lệ rời bỏ; động từ "churn" = hủy dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: churn /tʃɜːn/ (noun): the rate of customers leaving. "Churn rate" is the share of customers who leave; to churn is to cancel.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: by the time you see them worsen, it is too late to intervene.", từ "worsen" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: by the time you see them worsen, it is too late to intervene.", what does "worsen" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: worsen /ˈwɜː.sən/ (động từ): xấu đi. Trái nghĩa: improve. "Could worsen because of it" = có thể xấu đi vì nó.
items.explanationEn: worsen /ˈwɜː.sən/ (verb): to get worse. Opposite: improve. "Could worsen because of it" means it may get worse as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: by the time you see them worsen, it is too late to intervene.", từ "intervene" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: by the time you see them worsen, it is too late to intervene.", what does "intervene" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to step in to change things
items.explanation: intervene /ˌɪn.təˈviːn/ (động từ): can thiệp. Danh từ: intervention. "Too late to intervene" = quá muộn để can thiệp.
items.explanationEn: intervene /ˌɪn.təˈviːn/ (verb): to step in to change things. Noun: intervention. "Too late to intervene" means too late to act.

items.question: Trong câu "Leading indicators measure BEHAVIOUR that predicts those outcomes: how often a user performs the core action in week one, time to second use.", từ "predict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leading indicators measure BEHAVIOUR that predicts those outcomes: how often a user performs the core action in week one, time to second use.", what does "predict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (động từ): dự báo. Danh từ: prediction. Chỉ số dẫn dắt "predicts outcomes" = báo trước kết quả.
items.explanationEn: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (verb): to say what will happen. Noun: prediction. A leading indicator "predicts outcomes" before they occur.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: they are only a hypothesis — the link to the outcome must be validated.", từ "hypothesis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: they are only a hypothesis — the link to the outcome must be validated.", what does "hypothesis" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an idea still to be tested
items.explanation: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθ.ə.sɪs/ (danh từ): giả thuyết. Số nhiều: hypotheses. "Test a hypothesis" = kiểm chứng giả thuyết.
items.explanationEn: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθ.ə.sɪs/ (noun): an idea still to be tested. Plural: hypotheses. "Test a hypothesis" means check whether it holds.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: they are only a hypothesis — the link to the outcome must be validated.", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: they are only a hypothesis — the link to the outcome must be validated.", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): kiểm chứng, xác nhận. "Validate an assumption" = kiểm chứng một giả định bằng dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to check and confirm. "Validate an assumption" means confirm it with data.

items.question: Trong câu "A mature team watches BOTH: lagging indicators to know where you are, leading indicators to know where you are heading.", từ "mature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mature team watches BOTH: lagging indicators to know where you are, leading indicators to know where you are heading.", what does "mature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mature /məˈtʃʊər/ (tính từ): trưởng thành, dày dạn. Danh từ: maturity. "A mature process" = quy trình đã ổn định.
items.explanationEn: mature /məˈtʃʊər/ (adjective): experienced and developed. Noun: maturity. "A mature process" is well established.

items.question: Trong câu "A mature team watches BOTH: lagging indicators to know where you are, leading indicators to know where you are heading.", từ "head" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mature team watches BOTH: lagging indicators to know where you are, leading indicators to know where you are heading.", what does "head" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: head /hed/ (động từ): đi về hướng. "Be heading (for/towards)" = đang đi về phía; "head a team" = dẫn dắt đội.
items.explanationEn: head /hed/ (verb): to move towards. "Be heading (for/towards)" means moving in a direction; "head a team" means lead it.

items.question: Trong câu "That is your candidate.", từ "candidate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is your candidate.", what does "candidate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: candidate /ˈkæn.dɪ.dət/ (danh từ): phương án tiềm năng. Nghĩa phổ biến là ứng viên; ở đây là một chỉ số "ứng cử" cần kiểm chứng.
items.explanationEn: candidate /ˈkæn.dɪ.dət/ (noun): a possible choice to consider. Usually a job applicant; here a metric proposed for testing.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not forget the counter metric: whenever you optimise one metric, watch a metric that could worsen because of it.", từ "counter" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not forget the counter metric: whenever you optimise one metric, watch a metric that could worsen because of it.", what does "counter" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: counter /ˈkaʊn.tər/ (tính từ): đối trọng, ngược chiều. "Counter metric" = chỉ số đối trọng; "counter" danh từ còn là quầy hoặc bộ đếm.
items.explanationEn: counter /ˈkaʊn.tər/ (adjective): acting in the opposite direction. A "counter metric" balances another; as a noun counter also means a desk or a tally.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch complaint rate and uninstall rate alongside it.", từ "complaint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch complaint rate and uninstall rate alongside it.", what does "complaint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complaint /kəmˈpleɪnt/ (danh từ): lời phàn nàn. Động từ: complain (about). "File a complaint" = gửi khiếu nại.
items.explanationEn: complaint /kəmˈpleɪnt/ (noun): an expression of dissatisfaction. Verb: complain (about). "File a complaint" means lodge one formally.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch complaint rate and uninstall rate alongside it.", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch complaint rate and uninstall rate alongside it.", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): song song với, cùng với. "Work alongside someone" = làm việc cùng ai đó.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Work alongside someone" means work together with them.

items.question: Trong câu "Five stages of the user journey, each a place users can leak away:", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Five stages of the user journey, each a place users can leak away:", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): rò rỉ, thất thoát. Danh từ leak = chỗ rò; "memory leak" = rò rỉ bộ nhớ; "leak data" = lộ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to escape gradually. Noun leak = a hole or loss; "memory leak"; "leak data" means expose it.

items.question: Trong câu "A common mistake: pouring everything into Acquisition while the real leak is at Activation.", từ "pour" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common mistake: pouring everything into Acquisition while the real leak is at Activation.", what does "pour" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put lots of resources into
to let liquid flow from a container
items.explanation: pour /pɔːr/ (động từ): dồn, đổ (nguồn lực). "Pour money/effort into X" = đổ tiền/công sức vào X.
items.explanationEn: pour /pɔːr/ (verb): to put lots of resources into. "Pour money or effort into X" means invest heavily in X.

items.question: Trong câu "Adding more users to a leaking bucket only raises cost.", từ "bucket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding more users to a leaking bucket only raises cost.", what does "bucket" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (danh từ): cái xô. "A leaking bucket" là ẩn dụ: đổ thêm vào mà vẫn chảy mất.
items.explanationEn: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (noun): a pail for carrying water. "A leaking bucket" is a metaphor: whatever you add keeps draining away.

items.question: Trong câu "A single metric reflecting the core value the product delivers to users.", từ "reflect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A single metric reflecting the core value the product delivers to users.", what does "reflect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (động từ): phản ánh. "Reflect on" = suy ngẫm; "reflect value" = thể hiện giá trị.
items.explanationEn: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (verb): to show or express. "Reflect on" means think about; "reflect value" means show it.

items.question: Trong câu "Three criteria: it reflects user value, it predicts long-term revenue, and the team can influence it.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three criteria: it reflects user value, it predicts long-term revenue, and the team can influence it.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều: criteria. "Meet the criteria" = đáp ứng tiêu chí.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Plural: criteria. "Meet the criteria" means satisfy the standards.

items.question: Trong câu "Three criteria: it reflects user value, it predicts long-term revenue, and the team can influence it.", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three criteria: it reflects user value, it predicts long-term revenue, and the team can influence it.", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (động từ): tác động tới. Cũng là danh từ: "have influence over" = có ảnh hưởng tới.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (verb): to have an effect on. Also a noun: "have influence over" means be able to affect.

items.question: Trong câu "It is the convergence point that lets the whole organisation speak one language, while detailed metrics still live underneath for each team.", từ "convergence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the convergence point that lets the whole organisation speak one language, while detailed metrics still live underneath for each team.", what does "convergence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convergence /kənˈvɜː.dʒəns/ (danh từ): sự hội tụ. Động từ: converge. Trái nghĩa: divergence (sự phân kỳ).
items.explanationEn: convergence /kənˈvɜː.dʒəns/ (noun): coming together at one point. Verb: converge. Opposite: divergence.

items.question: Trong câu "It is the convergence point that lets the whole organisation speak one language, while detailed metrics still live underneath for each team.", từ "underneath" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the convergence point that lets the whole organisation speak one language, while detailed metrics still live underneath for each team.", what does "underneath" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: underneath /ˌʌn.dəˈniːθ/ (trạng từ): ở bên dưới. Tương tự: beneath, below. Ở đây nghĩa là ở tầng chi tiết hơn.
items.explanationEn: underneath /ˌʌn.dəˈniːθ/ (adverb): below, at a lower level. Similar: beneath, below. Here it means at a more detailed level.

items.question: Trong câu "Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task success — useful when you need to measure experience rather than only business outcomes.", từ "adoption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task success — useful when you need to measure experience rather than only business outcomes.", what does "adoption" (noun) mean?
options: mức độ chấp nhận sử dụng
optionsEn: uptake of a product by users
taking a child as your own
items.explanation: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (danh từ): mức độ chấp nhận sử dụng. Động từ: adopt. "Feature adoption" = tỉ lệ người dùng bắt đầu dùng tính năng.
items.explanationEn: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (noun): uptake of a product by users. Verb: adopt. "Feature adoption" is how many users start using a feature.

items.question: Trong câu "A/B testing splits users into two random groups and compares a single change.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A/B testing splits users into two random groups and compares a single change.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia tách. "Split into" = chia thành; "split the bill" = chia tiền.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split into" means divide into; "split the bill" means share the cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A/B testing splits users into two random groups and compares a single change.", từ "random" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A/B testing splits users into two random groups and compares a single change.", what does "random" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: random /ˈræn.dəm/ (tính từ): ngẫu nhiên. "At random" = một cách ngẫu nhiên; chia ngẫu nhiên giúp hai nhóm tương đương.
items.explanationEn: random /ˈræn.dəm/ (adjective): chosen by chance. "At random" means by chance; random groups keep the comparison fair.

items.question: Trong câu "Four conditions for a meaningful A/B test:", từ "meaningful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four conditions for a meaningful A/B test:", what does "meaningful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: meaningful /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.fəl/ (tính từ): có ý nghĩa, đáng tin. "Meaningful results" = kết quả có giá trị thực, không phải ngẫu nhiên.
items.explanationEn: meaningful /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.fəl/ (adjective): useful and significant. "Meaningful results" carry real weight rather than noise.

items.question: Trong câu "With low traffic a test can take months — and in those months the market has changed.", từ "traffic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With low traffic a test can take months — and in those months the market has changed.", what does "traffic" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: visits to a website or app
items.explanation: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (danh từ): lượng truy cập. "Web traffic" = lượt truy cập; "drug trafficking" lại là buôn lậu.
items.explanationEn: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (noun): visits to a website or app. "Web traffic" means visits; "trafficking" means illegal trade.

items.question: Trong câu "Long enough to cover a full behaviour cycle.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long enough to cover a full behaviour cycle.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (danh từ): chu kỳ. "Release cycle" = chu kỳ phát hành; "life cycle" = vòng đời.
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (noun): a repeating period. "Release cycle" and "life cycle" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Weekend behaviour differs from weekdays; stopping after three days is self-deception.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weekend behaviour differs from weekdays; stopping after three days is self-deception.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác với. "Differ from" = khác với; "differ on" = bất đồng về điều gì.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from" means be unlike; "differ on" means disagree about.

items.question: Trong câu "Weekend behaviour differs from weekdays; stopping after three days is self-deception.", từ "self-deception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weekend behaviour differs from weekdays; stopping after three days is self-deception.", what does "self-deception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: self-deception /ˌself.dɪˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tự lừa dối. Từ deceive (lừa dối). Dừng test sớm là tự lừa mình bằng dữ liệu chưa đủ.
items.explanationEn: self-deception /ˌself.dɪˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): fooling yourself. From deceive. Stopping a test early fools you with incomplete data.

items.question: Trong câu "Three limits to admit:", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three limits to admit:", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit a mistake" = thừa nhận sai lầm; "admitted to hospital" = nhập viện.
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to accept as true. "Admit a mistake" means own up to it; "admitted to hospital" means let in.

items.question: Trong câu "A/B testing optimises locally very well but does not find new ideas.", từ "locally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A/B testing optimises locally very well but does not find new ideas.", what does "locally" (adverb) mean?
options: cục bộ, trong phạm vi hẹp
items.explanation: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): cục bộ, trong phạm vi hẹp. "Local optimum" = điểm tối ưu cục bộ, chưa chắc là tốt nhất toàn cục.
items.explanationEn: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (adverb): within a narrow range. A "local optimum" is best nearby but not necessarily best overall.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not measure long-term impact.", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not measure long-term impact.", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động. "Have an impact on" = có tác động lên.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect. "Have an impact on" means affect.

items.question: Trong câu "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", từ "erode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", what does "erode" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (động từ): bào mòn dần. Nghĩa gốc là xói mòn (đất); "erode trust" = làm mất dần lòng tin.
items.explanationEn: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (verb): to wear away slowly. Literally soil wearing away; "erode trust" means weaken it over time.

items.question: Trong câu "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", từ "lift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", what does "lift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lift /lɪft/ (động từ): làm tăng. Danh từ "lift" trong phân tích = mức tăng; "lift a ban" = gỡ lệnh cấm.
items.explanationEn: lift /lɪft/ (verb): to raise a figure. As a noun in analytics, lift is the gain; "lift a ban" means remove it.

items.question: Trong câu "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", từ "conversion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", what does "conversion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the share doing a desired action
items.explanation: conversion /kənˈvɜː.ʃən/ (danh từ): tỉ lệ chuyển đổi. "Conversion rate" = tỉ lệ người dùng thực hiện hành động mong muốn, như mua hàng.
items.explanationEn: conversion /kənˈvɜː.ʃən/ (noun): the share doing a desired action. "Conversion rate" is the share of users who take the target action, like buying.

items.question: Trong câu "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", từ "show up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A change lifting conversion 5 percent while eroding trust only shows up months later.", what does "show up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: show up /ʃəʊ ˈʌp/ (cụm từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. "Show up" còn có nghĩa là đến (họp); "show someone up" = làm ai bẽ mặt.
items.explanationEn: show up /ʃəʊ ˈʌp/ (phrase): to become visible. "Show up" also means arrive; "show someone up" means embarrass them.

items.question: Trong câu "Stopping a test the moment results look good is cheating yourself.", từ "cheat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stopping a test the moment results look good is cheating yourself.", what does "cheat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cheat /tʃiːt/ (động từ): lừa dối, gian lận. "Cheat yourself" = tự lừa mình; "cheat on a test" = gian lận khi thi.
items.explanationEn: cheat /tʃiːt/ (verb): to deceive or act dishonestly. "Cheat yourself" means fool yourself; "cheat on a test" means act dishonestly.

items.question: Trong câu "Set a target of tickets closed per week and the team splits tickets.", từ "target" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set a target of tickets closed per week and the team splits tickets.", what does "target" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: target /ˈtɑː.ɡɪt/ (danh từ): chỉ tiêu, mục tiêu. "Set / hit / miss a target" = đặt / đạt / trượt chỉ tiêu.
items.explanationEn: target /ˈtɑː.ɡɪt/ (noun): a goal to reach. "Set / hit / miss a target" are the usual verbs.

items.question: Trong câu "The defence: measure outcomes, not output.", từ "defence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The defence: measure outcomes, not output.", what does "defence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defence /dɪˈfens/ (danh từ): cách phòng tránh. Chính tả Mỹ: defense. "The best defence against X" = cách chống X tốt nhất.
items.explanationEn: defence /dɪˈfens/ (noun): a way to protect against. American spelling defense. "The best defence against X" means the best protection.

items.question: Trong câu "The defence: measure outcomes, not output.", từ "output" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The defence: measure outcomes, not output.", what does "output" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (danh từ): sản lượng đầu ra. Output = khối lượng làm ra (ticket, tính năng); outcome = thay đổi thực sự cho người dùng.
items.explanationEn: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (noun): the amount produced. Output is volume produced (tickets, features); outcome is the real change for users.

items.question: Trong câu "Mistaking correlation for causation.", từ "mistake" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mistaking correlation for causation.", what does "mistake" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to wrongly think one thing is another
items.explanation: mistake /mɪˈsteɪk/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn (A với B). Cấu trúc "mistake A for B" = nhầm A là B.
items.explanationEn: mistake /mɪˈsteɪk/ (verb): to wrongly think one thing is another. Pattern: "mistake A for B" means wrongly take A to be B.

items.question: Trong câu "Mistaking correlation for causation.", từ "correlation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mistaking correlation for causation.", what does "correlation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: correlation /ˌkɒr.əˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tương quan. "Correlation is not causation" = tương quan không phải là nhân quả.
items.explanationEn: correlation /ˌkɒr.əˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): two things varying together. "Correlation is not causation" is a classic data warning.

items.question: Trong câu "Mistaking correlation for causation.", từ "causation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mistaking correlation for causation.", what does "causation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: causation /kɔːˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): quan hệ nhân quả. Liên quan: cause (nguyên nhân), causal (thuộc nhân quả).
items.explanationEn: causation /kɔːˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one thing causing another. Related: cause, causal.

items.question: Trong câu "Users of feature X retain better — that does not mean forcing everyone onto X will raise retention.", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users of feature X retain better — that does not mean forcing everyone onto X will raise retention.", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ chân, ở lại. Danh từ: retention. "Retain customers" = giữ chân khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep, to stay on. Noun: retention. "Retain customers" means keep them.

items.question: Trong câu "It may be that committed users go looking for X.", từ "committed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It may be that committed users go looking for X.", what does "committed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: committed /kəˈmɪt.ɪd/ (tính từ): tận tâm, gắn bó. "Be committed to" = tận tâm với; trong Git, committed là đã lưu thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: committed /kəˈmɪt.ɪd/ (adjective): dedicated and loyal. "Be committed to" means dedicated to; in Git, committed means saved.

items.question: Trong câu "Look at the 95th and 99th percentiles, not only the mean.", từ "percentile" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look at the 95th and 99th percentiles, not only the mean.", what does "percentile" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rank point in a distribution
items.explanation: percentile /pəˈsen.taɪl/ (danh từ): bách phân vị. P95 = 95% giá trị thấp hơn mức này; hay dùng để đo độ trễ.
items.explanationEn: percentile /pəˈsen.taɪl/ (noun): a rank point in a distribution. P95 means 95% of values fall below it; common for latency.

items.question: Trong câu "Look at the 95th and 99th percentiles, not only the mean.", từ "mean" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look at the 95th and 99th percentiles, not only the mean.", what does "mean" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mean /miːn/ (danh từ): giá trị trung bình. "The means" (có s) = phương tiện; "median" = trung vị, khác với mean.
items.explanationEn: mean /miːn/ (noun): the average value. "Means" with s is a method; the median is the middle value, not the mean.

items.question: Trong câu "A practical rule: each team should have about three to five primary metrics.", từ "primary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A practical rule: each team should have about three to five primary metrics.", what does "primary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: primary /ˈpraɪ.mər.i/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "Primary school" = tiểu học; "primary key" = khóa chính.
items.explanationEn: primary /ˈpraɪ.mər.i/ (adjective): main, most important. "Primary school" is for young children; "primary key" is a database term.

items.question: Trong câu "Fewer and you are blind, more and nobody truly watches them and every number becomes dashboard decoration.", từ "decoration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fewer and you are blind, more and nobody truly watches them and every number becomes dashboard decoration.", what does "decoration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đồ trang trí. "Dashboard decoration" = con số chỉ để trang trí bảng, không ai dùng.
items.explanationEn: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): something added for looks. "Dashboard decoration" means numbers shown for looks that nobody uses.

items.question: Trong câu "Most important of all: every metric needs an owner, an expected threshold, and a review cadence.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most important of all: every metric needs an owner, an expected threshold, and a review cadence.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Alert threshold" = ngưỡng cảnh báo; "on the threshold of" = sắp sửa.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (noun): a level that triggers action. "Alert threshold" triggers a warning; "on the threshold of" means about to.

items.question: Trong câu "Most important of all: every metric needs an owner, an expected threshold, and a review cadence.", từ "cadence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most important of all: every metric needs an owner, an expected threshold, and a review cadence.", what does "cadence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rise and fall of a voice
items.explanation: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): nhịp độ định kỳ. "Weekly review cadence" = nhịp rà soát hàng tuần.
items.explanationEn: cadence /ˈkeɪ.dəns/ (noun): a regular rhythm of events. "Weekly review cadence" means reviewing every week.

items.question: Trong câu "Clicks are easy to collect; whether users actually solved their problem is hard — yet that is the thing worth knowing.", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clicks are easy to collect; whether users actually solved their problem is hard — yet that is the thing worth knowing.", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): đáng (làm gì). "Worth + V-ing" = đáng làm; "worth $10" = trị giá 10 đô.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): deserving the effort. "Worth + -ing" means deserving it; "worth $10" gives a value.

items.question: Trong câu "Without measurement you cannot tell value from busyness.", từ "busyness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without measurement you cannot tell value from busyness.", what does "busyness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: busyness /ˈbɪz.i.nəs/ (danh từ): sự bận rộn. Khác với business (kinh doanh) dù cùng gốc busy.
items.explanationEn: busyness /ˈbɪz.i.nəs/ (noun): the state of being busy. Not the same as business, though both come from busy.

items.question: Trong câu "Measurement is the only way to distinguish real value from busyness, and it belongs to the Product Owner.", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measurement is the only way to distinguish real value from busyness, and it belongs to the Product Owner.", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B" = phân biệt A với B; dễ nhầm với extinguish (dập tắt).
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" means tell them apart; do not confuse with extinguish.

items.question: Trong câu "AARRR: teams pile into Acquisition while the leak sits at Activation.", từ "pile into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AARRR: teams pile into Acquisition while the leak sits at Activation.", what does "pile into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pile into /ˈpaɪl ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): dồn hết vào. "Pile into" = ùa vào, dồn vào; danh từ pile = đống.
items.explanationEn: pile into /ˈpaɪl ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to crowd into together. "Pile into" means rush in together; a pile is a heap.

items.question: Trong câu "A/B testing is powerful but clearly bounded, and the four measurement traps hollow out any dashboard if ignored.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A/B testing is powerful but clearly bounded, and the four measurement traps hollow out any dashboard if ignored.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): có giới hạn. Danh từ: bound, boundary (ranh giới). "Out of bounds" = vượt giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): having limits. Nouns: bound, boundary. "Out of bounds" means beyond the limits.

items.question: Trong câu "A/B testing is powerful but clearly bounded, and the four measurement traps hollow out any dashboard if ignored.", từ "hollow out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A/B testing is powerful but clearly bounded, and the four measurement traps hollow out any dashboard if ignored.", what does "hollow out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: hollow out /ˌhɒl.əʊ ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): làm rỗng giá trị. Tính từ hollow = rỗng; "hollow out" nghĩa bóng là làm mất giá trị bên trong.
items.explanationEn: hollow out /ˌhɒl.əʊ ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to empty of real value. Hollow means empty; figuratively "hollow out" drains the substance.
